slides.title: Tigray: four developments in 48 hours
slides.body: What Wazema Radio reported on Nov 24-25.

slides.title: Drone strikes near Gemahlo
slides.body: Wazema says strikes reportedly hit an arms depot in Tahtay Adiyabo on Monday. Its sources reported no casualties. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Mekelle eases night curbs
slides.body: From Nov 23, vehicles may move until 10 p.m. Limits on bajaj and motorcycles after 8 p.m. remain.

slides.title: South Tigray appointments cancelled
slides.body: The caretaker administration revoked all zonal, district and town appointments after community complaints, Wazema reports.

slides.title: Election board prepares for Tigray
slides.body: NEBE asked the caretaker administration for a liaison and logistics. No election date has been announced.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
